feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 5:46am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon, risk of gales.


##Wind)##

S or SE 3 to 5, gradually veering W or NW 5 to 7 during the morning, then increasing 6 or 7, perhaps locally gale 8 in the afternoon. Decreasing 5 or 6 into this evening, then 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate by mid-morning, then moderate or rough this afternoon. Falling mainly moderate this evening, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain clearing to showers this afternoon, then mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor in rain becoming mostly good in the afternoon, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds to gale force winds developing later.


##Wind)##

W or NW 4 or 5, decreasing SW 3 or 4 around midday, then gradually backing SE during the afternoon. Increasing E or SE 5 or 6 overnight, then backing N'ly 5 to 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight building moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then heavy rain overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Friday, 23 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales or Severe Gales.


##Wind)##

N or NW 7 or Gale 8, risk of Severe Gale 9 for a time, decreasing 6 or 7 in the evening, then 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough soon becoming rough or very rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Rain clearing to showers later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor becoming moderate or good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Saturday, 24 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, then gales developing overnight.


##Wind)##

NW 5 or 6, quickly decreasing W or SW 4 or 5, increasing S 5 or 6, occasionally 7, veering W or SW later, then increasing 7 or gale 8 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate becoming rough, then rough or very rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then rain arriving in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Sunday, 25 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales, risk of Severe Gales.


##Wind)##

W or SW 7 or gale 8, occasionally severe gale 9, decreasing 5 or 6 in the evening, then SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Very rough becoming rough, then moderate later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
